result.brief: 研究视觉-语言嵌入流形（欧氏/球面/双曲）上的可分解基元表征，提出组合评分函数，揭示组合结构在 CLIP、DINOv2 等模型中普遍涌现。
result.reason: Analyzes geometric structure of CLIP/DINOv2 vision-language embedding manifolds (Euclidean, spherical, hyperbolic) and decomposable primitive representations, directly informing visual representation learning.
